title: In club bridge, you're scored against players who held exactly the same cards
alt: A black bidding box full of small bid cards, a fanned hand of playing cards and a single card reading 1 NT, on green baize.

posts.facebook:
Think card games are all about luck? Club bridge is built to even the luck out.

In a club, several tables play the same hands in turn. Your score is compared with everyone else who held exactly the same cards, so it comes down to how well you played them.

To begin, try MiniBridge, a free practice game. Then the English Bridge Union or the American Contract Bridge League can help you find lessons and a club with games for newcomers.

What's your favorite card game?

How to start, and where to go → https://dontdieretired.com/list/learn-to-play-bridge/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=things-to-do
